AUTHOR: Ottaviani
TITLE: Assessing the Image Concept Drift at the OBSEA Coastal Underwater Cabled Observatory
REGION: OBSEA cabled observatory, 20 m depth, Vilanova i la Geltru, Catalonia, NW Mediterranean (Spain)
SPECIES: 14 Mediterranean coastal fish classes with >200 individuals (e.g. Diplodus vulgaris, Oblada melanura, Chromis chromis, Coris julis); 30 species annotated
DATA: Own OBSEA observatory images, one every 30 min, Jan-Dec 2014 (14,025 images; 62,038 annotated individuals, 29,497 to species)
V_EV: Study Area: 'Figures 1D, E shows two examples of acquisition conditions characterised by turbid water and biofouling on the porthole of the camera'
D2: Exp 1: random 50/50 split of individuals; Exp 2-3: random 30% of individuals per species from Jan-Apr for training, all remaining data tested month by month
D_EV: Results, Exp 1: 'The data partition being completely random and unrelated with time, this result represents an estimate of the best performance achievable with this kind of images.'
R_EV: Results, Exp 2: 'A sensible drop of classification performance occurred in December ... a new camera with a different colour balance mechanism substituted the old one'; overall accuracy 93.7% (random) vs 72.6% (time-ordered)
C_EV: no statement found (no detection/classification score threshold reported; confidence thresholds only proposed for a future incremental-learning service in Discussion)
E_EV: Materials and Methods: 'Besides the confusion matrix, other five criteria were used to evaluate the classification performance' (recall, FNR, precision, FDR, accuracy) - no ecological variable derived
ARCH: ResNet18 (only final FC layers trained) for species classification; Faster R-CNN for class-agnostic fish detection
METR: Confusion matrix, recall/TPR, FNR, precision, FDR, accuracy (monthly); detection recall (monthly)
NOTE: Classification and detection run as separate experiments; TYPE coded 분류 (2 of 3 experiments), verifier may prefer 파이프라인(복합) or 검출. D: training individuals randomly sampled from Jan-Apr while the remaining Jan-Apr individuals are also in the test stream, so the split unit is individual/image with a temporal hold-out for May-Dec; coded 이미지/프레임 무작위 with D4 = Y (paper explicitly contrasts random vs time-ordered partition) -> D_ALL P; a verifier who treats the time-ordered design as the split unit would code 조사일 -> D_ALL Y. R: later months (different season, changed species composition) and a camera replacement on 11 Dec 2014 -> R1 = Y, R2 = 복수, numeric drop reported (93.7% vs 72.6%; 72.6% -> 88.8% without December) -> R_ALL Y; same observatory though, P2 lists season and camera system as qualifying. V4 = Y (artificial reef 3.5 m from camera); V3 = Y (LED lighting specs, day/night). Fish far from camera excluded from training but visibility not used for exclusion. 'Unknown' class is a human-annotation category, not a model reject option (C4 N). No AI-derived abundance compared with counts, E1 = 없음.
